annotations.title: City walkability and its best and least served areas

description: A city's typical Walkably score (0 to 100, for where people live), its rank among the cities of the same country with a Walkably page (for example rank 1 of 36 cities in Spain), the median walk to each of eight daily needs, and the five best and five least served areas of the city, exactly as on its walkably.org city page. 477 cities in 31 European countries. This server is for single places in a conversation. Lists of addresses and bulk use go through the Walkably API: https://walkably.org/business/api/

city.description: City name in English or the local language, e.g. "Barcelona", "München", "Hamburg". A country can follow after a comma: "Valencia, Spain".

country.description: Optional: country name or two-letter code (es, de, gb ...) when a city name exists in several countries.

name: city_ranking
